subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper own crawl-remote production deployment under this hard-bound operator, protected-environment, and Cloudflare-token design?
rationale: The patch demonstrates strong fail-closed mechanics, but code review cannot authorize cross-repository production ownership, select the permanent operator policy, provision the live credential, or accept the rollout and recovery risk.

options.title: Approve controlled rollout
options.body: Accept this control plane after independently verifying environment protection, token permissions, the external release contract, and the dormant first-rollout and recovery procedure.

options.title: Keep deployment separate
options.body: Retain production deployment in crawl-remote or a dedicated operations repository if ClawSweeper should remain limited to maintenance and review automation.

recommendation.title: Approve controlled rollout
recommendation.body: Accept this control plane after independently verifying environment protection, token permissions, the external release contract, and the dormant first-rollout and recovery procedure.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the adjacent Cloudflare automation history, designed the proposed boundary, and are explicitly selected as its deployment operator.
